title: Peru Prime
short_description: Cusco – Sacred Valley – Ollantaytambo – Machu Picchu – Rainbow Mountain – Humantay Lake.
long_description: Explore the best of Peru in 7 days: from Lima to Cusco, discover history, culture, and iconic landscapes such as Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake and Rainbow Mountain.
price_note: Includes transportation, entrance tickets and professional guide.
seo_title: Peru Prime 7D/6N – Cusco, Machu Picchu and Top Attractions | GT Peru Travel
seo_description: Peru Prime 7 days: Sacred Valley, Cusco, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake and Rainbow Mountain. Complete package with transportation, entrances and professional guide.

days.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lima
days.text: Airport pickup and transfer to your hotel. Check-in available from 14:00. Optional Lima City Tour for morning arrivals.

days.title: Day 2: Paracas – Ballestas Islands – Ica – Huacachina
days.text: Early trip to Paracas for the Ballestas Islands. Continue to Ica for vineyard visit and tasting. Afternoon adventure in Huacachina with buggies and sandboarding. Return to Lima.

days.title: Day 3: Flight Lima – Cusco
days.text: Transfer to the airport and flight to Cusco. Reception and transfer to the hotel. Free afternoon to acclimatize or visit the Qosqo Center of Native Art.

days.title: Day 4: Machu Picchu
days.text: Train trip to Aguas Calientes and bus ascent to Machu Picchu. Guided tour through main attractions. Free time and return to Cusco in the afternoon.

days.title: Day 5: Humantay Lake
days.text: Early departure to Mollepata. Hike to Humantay Lake (4200 m). Time for photos and panoramic views. Return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 6: Rainbow Mountain
days.text: Trip to Cusipata, breakfast and hike to Vinicunca (5036 m). Amazing views of Ausangate. Return to Cusco in the afternoon.

days.title: Day 7: Departure
days.text: Transfer to the airport according to your flight schedule.
